candidates.name: Alpha Beta Gamer
candidates.reason: Explicitly invites in-development games, requires free public access for site features and appreciates footage and images.

candidates.name: IndieGameInn
candidates.reason: Free reviewed developer presentations; allows careful AI-assisted work but requires cohesive human oversight, cleared media and substantive commentary.

candidates.name: Indie Games Developer
candidates.reason: Offers free editorial consideration for indie games with a stated queue and no guarantee of coverage.

candidates.name: I Dream of Indie Games
candidates.reason: Active outlet focused on reviews, lists and visibility for smaller independent games; no clear official submission route verified.

candidates.name: Best Indie Games / ClemmyGames
candidates.reason: Active indie discovery channel and curator with 2026 showcases, but the visible route is Steam-oriented and Mythical is currently a browser game.

respectfulExclusions.name: Wholesome Games
respectfulExclusions.reason: Its official site states opposition to AI-generated art, while Mythical openly uses generative AI in its creative process.

respectfulExclusions.name: Wanderbots
respectfulExclusions.reason: The public channel description asks not to be contacted about games made with generative AI.
